I never went to school, can't read or write. But I know my land. My old man taught me, and I've been farming these 4 mu since before I can remember — I'm 33 now but it feels like 50 years. Three people in my house: me, my wife, and our boy. My wife works at the garment factory in town when they have orders, so most days it's just me in the fields.

I got 4.1 mu total. About 2.5 mu I do wheat then maize, same as everyone around here. The other 1.6 mu I grow cotton. My cousin says cotton is too much work, but my wife picks fast and we need the cash from cotton to get through the year.

**Winter wheat** — I planted it last October right after National Day. Used my own saved seed, didn't pay nothing for seed. Now it's March and the wheat is turning green. I need to put fertilizer on soon. Last year I used about one small bag of urea per mu at green-up — maybe 10 kg — and I only got about 380 kg per mu. Wasn't good. My neighbor Lao Wang used more, about a bag and a half per mu, and he got near 450 kg per mu. So this year I'm putting a bag and a half, about 15 kg urea per mu. Before planting I already put down one big bag of that compound stuff per mu — the shop calls it 15-15-15, I don't know what the numbers mean but it works.

I'll water three times: once with the fertilizer now, once when the wheat is jointing if it don't rain, and once when the grain is filling. Water costs electricity money for the pump, so I watch it careful. Last year was dry, I watered four times.

For weeds, I'll spray once in spring. Last year I was lazy and the weeds grew bad, cost me yield.

**Summer maize** — Soon as the wheat comes off in early June, I plant maize. Same day if I can get the machine, next day if I'm slow. I buy hybrid seed from the ag shop, costs about 40 yuan per mu. At planting I put down one big bag of compound fertilizer per mu. Then when the leaves get big — the trumpet stage — I put more urea, about a bag per mu, maybe 15 kg. I'll water once or twice. If it's dry when the tassels come out, I water for sure or the ears will be empty. Last year I got about 420 kg per mu, hoping for the same.

**Cotton** — I plant 1.6 mu in late April. Cotton seed is expensive, I buy hybrid from the shop, about 50 yuan per mu. I put base fertilizer at planting, one bag of compound per mu. Then I topdress twice — once when the yellow flowers come, once when the bolls get big. Each time about half a bag of urea per mu. Cotton needs more spraying for the bollworm. Last year I sprayed four times, this year probably three or four depending on if I see worms in the field. I'll water twice — once at flowering, once at boll time.

Labor is tight. It's mostly just me. My wife helps during wheat harvest and cotton picking, but she's at the factory most days. I hire nobody except the combine for wheat — costs about 70-80 yuan per mu. For cotton picking, me and my wife do it in the evenings after she gets back from town.

Money is the hard part. Fertilizer went up again at the shop. I thought about using less to save cash, but two years ago I cut back and the yield dropped bad — I lost more than I would have spent on fertilizer. So I use a bit more rather than too little. Better to waste some money than have a bad year and no food on the table. I always keep some cash back for emergencies, can't spend everything on inputs.

My total spending on all this is about 1,450 yuan this year. That's a lot for me, but I need the crops to come through.
